notes: No GM spec for wheel pilot lubricant found publicly. | round2_E evidence: GM bulletin 17-NA-235 specifies ACDelco M-77 paste (P/N 19356408 = MOLYKOTE M-77) for hub bearing surfaces; no public GM spec for wheel pilot hole lubricant found. | round2_E: Product unidentified; Liqui Moly Wheel Hub Paste (HTML page only) is an aftermarket analogue. Other Graco manual numbers seen (no URL): 307882 (15:1 Fire-Ball), 309869 (repair). | round3_review: REVIEW round3: MOLYKOTE M-77 for wheel pilot: WEAK. NHTSA TSB 17-NA-235 exists and specifies ACDelco M-77 (P/N 19356408), but on the hub BEARING surface of the Chevrolet City Express (a Nissan-built van), not the wheel pilot bore, and it is a service fix, not a plant spec. GM service notes only say 'GM-recommended grease' at the pilot, and another GM TSB uses MOLYKOTE Cu-7439 Plus on the hub spigot. So the M-77 TDS is an 'equivalent' candidate only (label OK); manufacturer stays unknown. The Graco Fire-Ball 300 manuals are drum pumps, not a fit for a 15 kg pail (weak).
